name: Assist with learning various foreign languages
description: Users asked for help learning various languages, including English, Spanish, French, and Japanese, by requesting explanations of grammar rules, vocabulary lists, pronunciation guides, and study strategies. They often sought structured roadmaps, specific instructional methods, or clarifications on complex linguistic concepts tailored to different proficiency levels.
